commonElements.details: Monthly, quarterly, and yearly views are available.
Range view supports from/to periods; single-period view focuses the dashboard on one selected period.
Operator selector supports all operators or a single selected operator when applicable.
Absolute values, quarter-on-quarter, year-on-year, and index views are supported for range analysis.
Each chart can expose its underlying data table.
The dashboard shows headline KPI cards from the visible charts in the active indicator section.
Exports visible chart data with dashboard, section, granularity, chart, unit, period, series, value, and source workbook.
Each dashboard includes an upload panel for replacing demo data with a live workbook dataset.
A forecast panel is available for the configured default metric and can switch to other chart metrics.
When a workbook is active, users can create custom charts and add dashboard-visible custom chart sections.

dataQualityNotes: The source document inventories indicator names, chart groupings, series, and source-sheet references, but it does not provide machine-readable observations.
No target values are defined in the source document, so actual-versus-target comparisons are intentionally not displayed.
Repeated graphs are preserved as separate placements when the document lists them in more than one dashboard section.
Units are not specified in the indicator tables and are therefore shown as unavailable rather than inferred.
Embedded screenshots are treated as visual references, not as authoritative observation datasets.
Historical observations are sourced from the authorized workbook-derived ZIP dataset, while indicator terminology and placement remain governed by the Word document.
Targets were not supplied. Forecasts shown by the dashboard are model-derived planning estimates and are not official projections.
Two workbook metrics (average mobile data subscriptions and average BWA subscriptions) are supporting series nested under their Word-defined usage-per-subscription indicators.
